sample_unit: PDMP prescription records for adults aged 65 and older
unlisted_practices: Retrieval-augmented explanations grounded in a curated clinical knowledge base of CDC opioid guidance and AGS Beers Criteria
Social Vulnerability Index (SVI) area-level context integrated into opioid risk prediction

screen.reason: The paper introduces and benchmarks a novel hybrid framework combining an LSTM risk model with a RAG-based LLM clinical explanation module on retrospective PDMP data, but it does not compare outcomes with vs. without a specific deployment safeguard.
